evidence.text: Tiger Woods PGA Tour 06 is a golf video game in the PGA Tour series available for PlayStation Portable , PlayStation 2 , Xbox , Xbox 360 , GameCube , Mobile phones , and PC .
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 07 is the ninth golfing video game in the PGA Tour series from EA Sports .
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 08 is the fourth-to-latest Tiger Woods golfing video game in the PGA Tour series from Electronic Arts .
Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 is a golfing video game in the PGA Tour series from Electronic Arts .
The Wii version is called Tiger Woods PGA Tour 09 All-Play , as part of EA Sports ' new brand for their Wii games from 2009 .
